performance.verdict: Throttle is working but intake ownership gap blocks any scale decision.

findings.text: Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 — 24 days overdue. GHL shows 38 opps created but 0 appointments logged, suggesting automation may be untested or broken.
Intake ownership unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7. GHL logs 77 contacts and 38 opps but 0 appointments — speed-to-lead automations may be pointing at an unmanned seat.
Leads field reads 0 across all 28 days despite 13 Google Ads conversions and 31 GBP calls. CPL is incalculable — attribution between LSA and GHL is broken or unmapped.
3-day spend signal (Aug 21–23): $20.77 + $0 + $62.48 = $83.25 vs prior 3 days (Aug 18–20): $16.06 + $21.63 + $84.70 = $122.39 — spend contracting, consistent with intentional throttle.
GBP actions fell 10% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 21–23) show 2 + 0 + 0 = 2 actions vs prior 3 (Aug 18–20): 1 + 17 + 2 = 20. Aug-22/23 GBP zeros likely Windsor lag, not real drop.

suggestions.text: Confirm live intake owner in GHL and test speed-to-lead automation end-to-end before any budget increase.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian left 7/7 and the booking bot battle-test is 24 days overdue (due 2026-07-31). Confirm who now owns the GHL intake seat, verify their login, and run a live end-to-end test of the speed-to-lead automation. Success check: at least 1 appointment logged in GHL within 5 minutes of a test lead submission, confirmed by 2026-08-28. No budget increases should be approved until this is resolved — it is the stated scale-back-up gate.

suggestions.text: Map LSA and GBP call conversions into GHL so CPL becomes calculable; 13 conversions and 31 calls are currently invisible to pipeline.
suggestions.monday_update: 28-day data shows 13 Google Ads conversions and 31 GBP calls, but the GHL leads field reads 0 — these are not flowing into pipeline. Audit the LSA lead notification destination and GBP call tracking to confirm they route to an active GHL workflow. Success check: leads field in next performance run reflects at least a portion of those 13 conversions, verifiable by 2026-08-31.

suggestions.text: Hold all budget changes; re-check Aug 27 once GBP lag clears and intake gate is confirmed.
suggestions.monday_update: Spend is intentionally throttled at ~$32/day average over the last 7 days and the scale-back-up gate (intake ownership) is unresolved. GBP zeros on Aug 22–23 are likely Windsor data lag, not a real drop. No budget move is warranted this cycle. Re-check on 2026-08-27 to confirm GBP lag has cleared and to assess whether the intake fix (S1) is complete before any scale discussion.
